HaploTraitR: Haplotype-Based Trait Analysis for Plant Breeding

Source: R/HaploTraitR-package.R
HaploTraitR-package.Rd

HaploTraitR turns GWAS hits into haplotype blocks (SNPs linked by LD), tests how each haplotype affects a trait, and reports the superior haplotypes, diagnostic markers and candidate parents in plots and a formatted Excel workbook.

Details

The quickest way to use the package is [run_haplotraitr()]. The individual steps ([read_gwas_file()], [readHapmap()], [getDistClusters()], ...) remain available for custom workflows.
